title.en: Caring clinicians but telephone customer service issues

text.en: Longstanding clients express deep gratitude for the veterinary team and nursing staff, praising their warmth and attentiveness during in-person examinations. However, multiple reviewers report dismissive telephone interactions and unhelpful reception communication when calling to enquire about fees or emergency visits.

Pet owners appreciate that veterinary assistants handle dogs and cats gently, creating a low-stress environment for both routine immunisations and senior pet check-ups. Clients note that staff demonstrate comfort handling various canine breeds and take care to minimise animal anxiety.

Several reviewers highlight prompt appointment scheduling and efficient clinic turnaround times during routine consultations. Clients appreciate being seen in a timely manner, noting that wait times for walk-in consultations frequently prove significantly shorter than initially estimated by receptionists.

q.en: Does Southeast Animal Hospital handle walk-in or emergency visits?

a.en: The clinic accommodates urgent cases during operational hours, though clients advise calling ahead as emergencies near closing time may be redirected.

q.en: Are pet grooming services provided on-site?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that the hospital provides pet grooming services and complimentary nail trims alongside veterinary visits.

q.en: How are consultation wait times described by pet owners?

a.en: Reviewers generally describe waiting times as prompt and efficient, with visits often concluding faster than expected.
